end.parentNote: Saanvi practised linking consecutive odd-number sums to square arrangements and correctly identified several square numbers. They mixed up the rule by extending it to odd-number runs that do not start at 1; this was not fully corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to check 1+3+5 and compare it with 3+5+7 before stating the rule.
